about_the_game:
Ashes & Blood is an isometric, turn-based strategy RPG set in a dark medieval fantasy world.
Choose your faction, exploit the land, and bend the rules of war to your will.
Whether you're crushing enemies in tactical TRPG-style battles or expanding
your reach across a procedurally generated 4X world,
the power is yours—and it's only growing.

The game features two interconnected modes:

World Mode, a dynamic 4X sandbox where you manage cities,
recruit armies, and try to conquer a procedurally generated map.

Battle Mode, a rich tactical layer of grid-based combat with elevation,
status effects, and devastating profession-based combos.

But what truly sets Ashes & Blood apart is its unapologetic embrace of player freedom

and broken builds. Want to exploit terrain generation to create a map tilted in your faction’s
favor? Do it. Want to stack professions into a synergy so absurd it melts enemies
in one turn? That’s the point. Each campaign you finish feeds into a meta-progression system,
unlocking even more powerful tools, traits, and map modifiers for future runs.
But don’t feel to save, the combat is fast-paced, brutal and the AI
WILL give you a hard time, if you’re not careful.

Dual Game Modes: Switch seamlessly between World Mode, a large-scale 4X
sandbox of exploration and conquest, and Battle Mode, a tactical TRPG-style
combat system with layered maps and precise unit control.

Factions: Choose from humans, orcs, or velkyn, each with unique units, professions,
and tactical philosophies. Every faction plays differently—and breaks differently.

Procedural Worldmap: Generate unique, strategic landscapes in a blink using
a custom algorithm that blends Voronoi diagrams, noise functions, and more.
Tweak parameters to tilt the world in your favor.

Meta-Progression: Finish a campaign to unlock powerful perks, traits, or entirely
new professions for your faction in future runs. Your victories echo forward.

Profession System: Customize units using a primary + secondary profession system.
Stack ability synergies, build around specific strategies, or experiment with broken combos.

Dynamic Combat: Master elevation, flanking, terrain effects, and
status interactions in intense, turn-based battles.

Generate world maps biased toward your faction

Stack buffs, debuffs, and status effects until the game engine trembles

Assign custom AI behaviors to individual units

Speed up time (to absurd amounts), automate armies, or micro
manage every aspect of the game - it is up to you!

Ashes & Blood
is a sandbox of strategy, designed to be broken by those clever enough to do it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or integrated equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 MB available space

short_description: Ashes & Blood is a dark fantasy strategy RPG with brutal tactical battles and a 4X sandbox campaign. Break the rules, build absurd combos, exploit the world, and unlock even more chaos with each run. Turn based strategy has never been this unhinged.
